limitations: Raw OS sampledAt was not retained; exact OS deltaSeconds was reconstructed from saved raw deltas and saved total-operation rate, checked against saved byte rates and millisecond precision. Absolute intervals use monitor wall timestamps. Counter classes identify kernel-accounted process I/O operations, not individual file/socket handles. No ETW/ProcMon attribution or physical disk latency/queue counters were captured.
Action counts group recorded client action-start wall time; they do not timestamp every kernel I/O operation or server completion.
Only this unique fresh actor pool and snapshot geometry were used; no repeated real probe after this guard stop.
